product_overview: A private, authenticated finance and crypto-research terminal for tracking personal portfolio activity, spending, BTC research signals, and public wallet smart-money events. It also includes an AI assistant that answers grounded questions using the user’s own data.
core_goals: Create and manage a private account with email and password
Track crypto portfolio transactions and view portfolio performance
Import Money Lover CSV spending data and review spending trends
Inspect daily BTC research signals with evidence and freshness
Monitor public wallets and smart-money events with late-entry warnings
Ask an AI assistant questions about portfolio, spending, BTC, and smart-money data

features.name: User Registration
features.description: Users create a private workspace using email and password before accessing the authenticated app.
user_flows: Navigate to /register -> Optionally enter a full name -> Enter an email address -> Enter a password -> Submit the registration form -> See inline validation errors when the email is invalid or the password is shorter than 8 characters
Navigate to /register -> Optionally enter a full name -> Enter an email address -> Enter a valid password -> Submit the registration form -> Get redirected to /onboarding
Navigate to /register -> Select the sign-in link -> Arrive at /sign-in

features.name: User Sign-in
features.description: Users sign in to access their existing workspace and are routed to the appropriate next step based on onboarding status.
user_flows: Navigate to /sign-in -> Enter an email address -> Enter a password -> Submit the sign-in form -> Get redirected to /overview or /onboarding
Navigate to /sign-in -> Enter an email address -> Enter a password -> Submit the sign-in form -> See an authentication error when credentials are invalid
Navigate to /sign-in -> Select the create account link -> Arrive at /register

features.name: Overview Dashboard
features.description: Authenticated users see a summary of their portfolio, spending, BTC signal, smart-money activity, and data-quality status.
user_flows: Navigate to /overview -> Observe total portfolio value, daily change, asset allocation, monthly spending, latest BTC signal, latest smart-money event, and data-quality warnings

features.name: Portfolio Ledger
features.description: Authenticated users manage crypto transactions for multiple assets and review portfolio analytics such as balances, allocation, and P&L.
user_flows: Navigate to /portfolio -> Record a transaction -> Enter asset, transaction type, quantity, execution price, fee, venue, and date -> Save the transaction -> Observe updated balances, allocation, average cost basis, realized P&L, and unrealized P&L
Navigate to /portfolio -> Edit an existing transaction -> Update the transaction details -> Save the changes -> Observe portfolio metrics recalculate
Navigate to /portfolio -> Delete a transaction -> Confirm removal -> Observe portfolio metrics recalculate
Navigate to /portfolio -> Import a supported transaction CSV -> Review imported rows -> Confirm the import -> Observe transactions appear in the ledger
Navigate to /portfolio -> Export portfolio data -> Download the exported file

features.name: Spending Analysis
features.description: Authenticated users review spending, income, and monthly trends after importing a Money Lover CSV export.
user_flows: Navigate to /spending -> Upload a Money Lover CSV export -> Review detected columns and mapped fields -> Preview validation issues, duplicates, and accepted rows -> Confirm the import -> Observe updated income, expenses, savings rate, category totals, and month-over-month changes
Navigate to /spending -> Upload a CSV with missing required mappings -> Review the mapping step -> Correct the mappings -> Continue the import flow

features.name: BTC Research
features.description: Authenticated users review the daily BTC/USD research signal, supporting evidence, signal confidence, and freshness.
user_flows: Navigate to /btc-research -> Observe the current BTC signal, confidence, freshness, market context, and evidence receipts
Navigate to /btc-research -> Open signal history -> Review prior signals and supporting evidence
Navigate to /btc-research -> Observe a WATCH signal when market data is stale, conflicting, or insufficient

features.name: Smart Money Watch
features.description: Authenticated users monitor public wallets, inspect wallet-driven token events, and review late-entry risk status.
user_flows: Navigate to /smart-money -> Review watched wallets, wallet classifications, and recent token-flow events
Navigate to /smart-money -> Open an event -> Inspect token, chain, contract address, DEX pair, liquidity, volume, price movement, transaction links, and evidence
Navigate to /smart-money -> Observe an EXTENDED or AVOID warning -> Review the late-entry risk explanation before acting

features.name: Ask Portfolio AI Assistant
features.description: Authenticated users ask grounded questions about their own portfolio, spending, BTC research, smart-money activity, and data quality.
user_flows: Navigate to /ask-portfolio -> Enter a question about portfolio, spending, BTC, or smart-money data -> Send the message -> Receive a grounded answer with source badges, freshness, and caveats
Navigate to /ask-portfolio -> Ask about data quality or missing information -> Receive a response that identifies data gaps or stale inputs
Navigate to /ask-portfolio -> Open a conversation -> Delete the conversation -> Observe the chat history removed

features.name: User Settings
features.description: Authenticated users configure account preferences such as display currency and timezone.
user_flows: Navigate to /settings -> Update display preferences such as currency or timezone -> Save changes -> Return to the app with updated settings

tech_stack: Tailwind CSS with Radix UI / shadcn-style components
Drizzle ORM (MySQL/TiDB), Better Auth, Recharts, Zustand, react-hook-form, zod, decimal.js

routes.description: Server-side redirect: unauthenticated users go to /sign-in; authenticated users with complete onboarding go to /overview, otherwise /onboarding. No visible landing content.
Public registration page rendering an email/password sign-up form (AuthPage mode=register).
Public sign-in page rendering an email/password login form (AuthPage mode=sign-in).
Post-registration setup page; redirects unauthenticated users to /sign-in.
Authenticated BTC research and daily signal view.

features.name: User Registration
features.description: Create a private workspace with email and password using Better Auth. Validates email format and enforces a minimum password length of 8 characters.
user_interactions: Optionally fill the Full name field
Submit by clicking the Continue to setup button
Observe inline validation errors when the email is invalid or the password is shorter than 8 characters
On successful registration get redirected to /onboarding
Click the Sign in link to switch to the /sign-in page

features.name: User Sign-in
features.description: Sign in to an existing workspace with email and password via Better Auth. On success the user is redirected to /overview when onboarding is complete, otherwise to /onboarding.
user_interactions: Submit by clicking the Open terminal button
Observe a server error message when credentials are invalid
On successful sign-in get redirected to /overview or /onboarding
Click the Create account link to switch to the /register page

features.name: Health Check API
features.description: Public unauthenticated health endpoint that verifies database connectivity. Returns 200 with status ok when the database is reachable, or 503 with status degraded when it is not.
user_interactions: Expect a 200 response with a JSON body containing status ok and database reachable

features.name: Overview Dashboard
features.description: Authenticated dashboard summarizing portfolio, spending, and data-quality status.

features.name: Portfolio Ledger
features.description: Authenticated CRUD for BUY, SELL, TRANSFER, REWARD, AIRDROP, and FEE transactions with import/export and analytics.

features.name: Spending Analysis
features.description: Authenticated income, expense, category, and month-over-month spending analysis with Money Lover CSV import preview.

features.name: BTC Research
features.description: Authenticated BTC market context, trend, volatility, latest signal, confidence, freshness, and signal history.

features.name: Smart Money Watch
features.description: Authenticated public-wallet watchlist and smart-money event inspection with late-entry risk alerts.

features.name: Ask Portfolio AI Assistant
features.description: Authenticated AI assistant answering portfolio, spending, BTC signal, smart-money, and data-quality questions using allowlisted server-side tools.

known_limitations.issue: Most application features require authentication; without a registered test account only registration, sign-in, and the /api/health endpoint can be exercised end-to-end.
known_limitations.impact: Authenticated flows (overview, portfolio, spending, BTC research, smart money, AI assistant, settings) cannot be tested without valid credentials.

known_limitations.issue: The root path / performs a server-side redirect and renders no visible public landing content.
known_limitations.impact: There is no public marketing or landing page to test for static content.
